title.ko: 관계절 who · which · that · where · whose
title.en: Relative clauses: who · which · that · where · whose

explain.ko: 관계절은 명사를 뒤에서 설명합니다. 사람에는 who / that, 사물에는 which / that, 장소에는 where, 소유에는 whose를 씁니다. 관계대명사가 관계절의 목적어일 때는 생략할 수 있습니다: The book (that) I bought. 하지만 주어일 때는 생략할 수 없습니다: a woman who teaches English. 보충 설명은 쉼표를 찍는 비제한 관계절로 쓰며 이때는 that을 쓰지 않습니다.
explain.en: A relative clause gives more information about a noun that comes before it. Use who / that for people, which / that for things, where for places and whose for possession. When the relative pronoun is the object of the clause it can be left out: The book (that) I bought. When it is the subject, it cannot be left out: a woman who teaches English. Extra information is added in a non-defining clause with commas, where 'that' is not used.

head: 대상 / For
관계사 / Pronoun
예문 / Example
rows: I know a woman who teaches English.

notes.ko: 관계절이 목적어를 설명할 때는 관계대명사를 생략할 수 있습니다.
notes.en: The pronoun can be left out when it is the object of the clause.

notes.ko: who는 사람, which는 사물, that은 둘 다에 씁니다.
notes.en: Who is for people, which for things, that for both.

notes.ko: 보충 설명에서는 쉼표를 쓰고 that을 쓰지 않습니다: My brother, who lives in Busan, …
notes.en: In a non-defining clause use commas and not 'that': My brother, who lives in Busan, …
